entry.title: Keystore Studio 1.0.0: first public release
entry.summary: The first public release, for Windows, macOS and Linux. No accounts, no telemetry, MIT licensed.
entry.content:
The first public release of Keystore Studio, a native workbench for Java keystores, PKCS#12 files and X.509 certificates. Download for Windows and Apple silicon Macs, or build from source on Linux.

  • Keystores. Open, create, edit and save PKCS#12, JKS, JCEKS, BKS, UBER and BCFKS side by side, convert between all six, undo and redo.
  • Certificates. PEM, DER, chains and PKCS#7 bundles on their own page; inspect, export, add to a keystore or workspace.
  • Examine. Live TLS inspection with a trust and hostname verdict, a connection test, decode and compare, OCSP and CRL revocation checks.
  • CA & Signing. Sign CSRs, issue CRLs, CMS/PKCS#7 and JWT sign and verify, JAR signing, RFC 3161 timestamps, DH parameters.
  • Convert. Every format conversion in one place, each showing the equivalent openssl, ssh-keygen or keytool command.
  • Security audit. A health score with findings, one-click key rotation and renewal, CSV report.
  • Vault and Workspaces. Passwords under one master key (Argon2id, AES-256-GCM); entries and certificates grouped by project.
  • Productivity. Command palette, built-in terminal, tool detection, drag and drop, session restore, light, dark and system themes.

Security and quality: interop tests against keytool, jarsigner, openssl and ssh-keygen; fuzzed parsers; a strict Content Security Policy; cargo deny in CI.
